## STRIPE - Webhook Handler

**Endpoint:** POST /webhook/stripe

**Source:** RFC-025 Section 14.1

**Description:**
Reçoit et valide les webhooks Stripe avec:
- Validation signature (stripe-signature)
- Protection replay attack (< 5 min)
- Idempotence (stripe_processed_events)
- Lock Redis (anti race conditions)
- Routing vers handlers par event.type

**Events gérés:**
- customer.subscription.updated
- customer.subscription.deleted
- invoice.payment_succeeded
- invoice.payment_failed
- payment_intent.succeeded
- checkout.session.completed

parameters.query: SELECT event_id, processed_at, result FROM stripe_processed_events WHERE event_id = '{{ $('Check Lock Result').first().json.event_id }}' LIMIT 1

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: 'Event already processed', event_id: $json.event_id, processed_at: $json.processed_at }) }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO stripe_processed_events (event_id, event_type, processed_at, result) VALUES ('{{ $json.event_id }}', '{{ $json.event_type }}', NOW(), '{{ JSON.stringify($json.result).replace(/'/g, "''") }}') ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
